summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of SimplDSC MVP. 33/33 backend pytest cases passed covering public catalog, DSC finder, OTP auth (send/verify/complete-profile/me), coupon validation, order creation with SD-YYYY-NNNNNN IDs, mock Razorpay payment verification (mock_sig_ prefix), invoice generation INV-YYYY-NNNNNN, document upload (PDF/JPG/PNG allow-list & 400 on invalid MIME), tenant isolation (customer B cannot access customer A order -> 404), admin login with super_admin role, admin dashboard/orders/detail with CAs list, document verify, CA assignment, status update, DSC issuance with ~10-day expiry, expiry-check idempotency (2nd run returns 0), expiry dashboard, DSC renewal request (duplicate blocked), product/coupon CRUD, audit logs populated, analytics, CSV export, staff creation and ticket creation TKT-YYYY-NNNNNN. Frontend E2E flows verified end-to-end: Home hero renders, DSC Finder purpose=business returns 3 recos, OTP modal (mobile->send->devOtp captured from network->OTP input->verify->profile step->save) logs the user in and lands on /dashboard, Buy Now on Product detail opens PurchaseModal, applicant->documents(skipped)->review->WELCOME10 coupon applied->pay-now-btn->purchase-success->goto-dashboard, order SD-2026-000003 appears with 'Documents Pending' status. Admin login at /admin/login with admin@simpldsc.in succeeds, dashboard shows revenue ₹1,799.10 and stat cards including 1 Expiring DSC entry (SPLDSC-2026-C-157535 Class 3, expires ~2026-10-04) proving expiry-check ran end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~530 lines and admin_routes.py is ~640 lines — consider splitting admin_routes.py into logical modules (orders, catalog, dsc, leads, settings) as scope grows past ~700 lines.

gen_simpldsc_id uses find_one_and_update with upsert=False, then a separate $setOnInsert upsert when the counter doesn't exist. This is technically racy under concurrent first-time inserts for the same year+quarter — 2 concurrent new customers could each read 'None' and both seed at 157535 producing duplicate simplDscId. Recommend using upsert=True with $inc + $setOnInsert on same call so the counter is atomically created at start-1 and incremented in one op. Same applies to gen_order_id/gen_invoice_no/gen_ticket_id.

run_expiry_check filters only status in [Active, Expiring Soon] but never flips a DSC to 'Expiring Soon' status — the computedStatus is only computed on read. So the persisted status stays 'Active' forever and expiry-dashboard 'renewing' bucket + status transitions rely on external code. Consider a background job that also mutates dsc.status when within 30 days.

OTP verify path returns detailed error messages that could aid enumeration ('Incorrect OTP', 'OTP already used', 'Invalid session'). Consider unifying to a single 'Invalid or expired OTP' response for prod.

Coupon per-customer-limit check counts by any order carrying that couponCode regardless of paymentStatus. A customer with a failed/cancelled order using WELCOME10 will still be blocked from a fresh attempt. Consider filtering by paymentStatus == 'Payment Successful'.

verify-payment does not require an idempotency guard — a duplicate call with the same razorpay ids will create a second invoice and second payment row for the same order. Recommend rejecting if order.paymentStatus == 'Payment Successful' already.
Document upload stores files as base64 inside Mongo docs (5MB cap). Works for MVP but will bloat DB; move to object storage before production.

Admin brute-force lockout counts failures across all IPs for an email but does not lock the account; a 429 is returned only while the 15-min window is active. Consider also capturing by IP and adding CAPTCHA after N fails.
@app.on_event('startup') and shutdown are deprecated in FastAPI; migrate to lifespan context manager.
CORS is allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True which browsers reject. Not an issue today because the app is same-origin, but tighten before production.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@simpldsc.in / Simpl@DSC#Admin2026Kx7q. Customer: any 10-digit mobile; devOtp returned in /api/auth/send-otp response.
seed_data_creation: Tests generated ephemeral customers (mobiles prefixed 9/8 + timestamp), 2+ orders SD-2026-* with WELCOME10 discount, 1 DSC with ~10d expiry, expiry reminder row, TEST_ contact/partnership leads, 1 support ticket TKT-2026-000001, 1 staff account teststaff_<ts>@x.com. These accumulate on repeated runs — main agent may prune in a fresh db.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is the regression suite; run via `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. The suite depends on a single fresh mobile per run for the OTP user (auto-generated from timestamp) and requires seeded products/coupons. Razorpay is MOCK so razorpaySignature must start with 'mock_sig_'. Frontend flow verified in headed run: home->DSC Finder->OTP login->Product detail Buy Now->PurchaseModal (5-step) -> WELCOME10 coupon -> mock pay -> dashboard order SD-2026-000003 visible with 'Documents Pending'. Admin dashboard renders full stat matrix including expiring DSC row after issuance flow. No blocking issues found.
